title: Structure and roof for an architect's own house, Drumcondra
role: Structural steel, second floor and roof structure, built by MF to the architect's drawings
summary: On site now: new steel frame, second floor and roof structure for an end-of-terrace house designed by About Place Architecture + Design.
intro: About Place Architecture + Design designed a new rear extension and second floor for this end-of-terrace house. We are building the structural package: temporary propping, the ground floor steel frame, the ridge beam, the second floor and the roof structure.
The image below is the architect's design. Progress photos will follow as the work continues.
